newsArray.title: India Under-19s Triumph Over Australia in Nail-Biting ODI
newsArray.description: In a gripping first Youth ODI, India Under-19s edged out Australia Under-19s by just 7 runs in Rajkot. Yashbardhan Chauhan was the star of the match, scoring a half-century and taking two wickets. Aryavir Sehwag and Anvay Dravid also made significant contributions, setting a competitive total for Australia to chase. Despite a valiant effort from the Australian side, they fell short in a nail-biting finish. The second ODI is set for September 21, promising more exciting cricket action.
